question: ______ arises from the interchange of ligands between cationic and anionic entities of different metal ions present in a complex
solution:
The correct answer is __**Coordination isomerism.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Coordination isomerism** is a form of** structural isomerism **in which the composition of the **coordination complex ion varies.**
 
• In a** coordination isomer **the total ratio of **ligand to metal remains** the same, but the** ligands attached to a specific metal ion change.**
 
• Examples of a complete series of **coordination isomers require** at least two metal ions and sometimes more.
